Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring libraries to offer filtering software for minor access to the internet.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to internet access for patrons of public libraries;and adding a new section to chapter 27.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 27.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Internetaccess terminals located in the children's area of alibrary shall be provided with filtering software that blocks, to theextent technically possible, access to potentially offensive materialincluding adultoriented, sexually explicit internet sites. Inlibraries where there is no internetaccess terminal in the children'sarea, a terminal located near the children's area shall be providedwith the filtering software. Library staff shall not monitor the useof internetaccess terminals in any way other than as directed bylibrary policy or state law. Internet access provided by a library to minors shall be filteredby filtering software as required by this section unless a parent orguardian notifies the library staff that the parent or guardian selectsunfiltered access as an alternative choice for his or her minor child.Any adult user may select filtered access. p. 1 SB 5242 For the purposes of this section, "minor" means a person under theage of eighteen years.
